purpose: Independent first-party registry/map discovery and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: Rosreestr's official public cadastral map is now routed through the National Spatial Data Platform (NSPD). Podolsk municipal property/land committee evidence establishes local procedural custody and cadastral-number use. The NSPD and legacy PKK hosts timed out for bounded anonymous requests, so no safe native parcel identity plus polygon was verified; no sample was retained and runtime remains held.
registryAssessment: Podolsk's official Committee for Property and Land Relations is a local municipal land/property custodian and publishes cadastral-number procedures. Rosreestr/NSPD is the national cadastral-map custodian. Neither was verified here as an accessible open parcel-vector endpoint.
